g.text: each native environment supplies one companion
Session Adapter in its trusted provider executable.
Exact signed tuples and observed bindings fail closed.
Source Adapter -> canonical contracts -> Target Adapter.
No source×target converter pair and no sink is a live native store.
This store is local to the executing AX host, not shared by all hosts.
Source and target native stores remain local and independently authoritative.
Rollback is retained through live validation/finalizing intent.
Provider commit discards it; post-commit byte rollback is forbidden.
